# Sanjeev Kumar

Sanjeev Kumar is a Level 3 personal trainer in South Surrey, British Columbia, Canada.

He offers in-person training packages, online consultations, and free guidance on longevity, mobility and endurance.

Credentials: NASM, ISSA, ProNatal and Hypervolt.

- Home: https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/
- About: https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/about.html
- Book a consultation: https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/book.html - choose a 15 or 30 minute meeting, then pick a time.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanjeev-kumar-0387b6207

Package sizes, session lengths and prices are not published. Consultations are booked on the booking page. Free guidance questions still go through the contact form.

Staying Active During Pregnancy: A Plain-Language Guide - https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/blog/staying-active-during-pregnancy.html - What current guidelines say about exercise during pregnancy, simple ways to stay active, warning signs to stop, and how to ease back after birth.
Starting From Zero: Your First Month of Training - https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/blog/your-first-month-of-training.html - New to exercise? A calm, week-by-week plan for your first month of training, with tips on soreness, habits and how to know it is working.
Mobility for Desk Workers: A 10-Minute Routine - https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/blog/mobility-for-desk-workers.html - Stiff hips, tight shoulders and a sore neck from desk work? Try these simple movement breaks and a 10-minute mobility routine.
Strength Training After 50: Where to Start - https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/blog/strength-training-after-50.html - A plain-language guide to starting strength training after 50: the basic movements, a simple weekly plan, and how to progress safely.
